evals.expected_output: prek.toml with [[repos]] for ruff-pre-commit and a local sqlfmt hook (no prettier), pyproject.toml updated with ruff+sqlfmt settings, prek install run
expectations: prek.toml uses [[repos]] array-of-tables structure
prek.toml has a repo = "https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff-pre-commit" entry with ruff-check and ruff-format hooks
prek.toml has a repo = "local" entry with a sqlfmt hook
prek.toml does NOT contain a biome hook (no TS files)
pyproject.toml contains [tool.ruff] with indent-width = 4 and line-length = 120
pyproject.toml contains [tool.ruff.lint] with select including ANN, PERF and UP, and ignore containing ANN401
prek.toml has a non-blocking ANN401 hook using --exit-zero
pyproject.toml contains [tool.sqlfmt] with line_length = 120
prek install is run to wire up the git hook

evals.prompt: Set up prek secret detection for my Azure DevOps repo. It has an azure-pipelines.yml that validates PRs, a justfile, and a 60 MB generated export at data/export.json. Some existing code has a hard-coded connection string with a password in config/dev.yaml.
evals.expected_output: prek.toml with detect-private-key (builtin) and detect-secrets (Yelp, --baseline .secrets.baseline) with the lock-file excludes plus data/export.json excluded, a staged .secrets.baseline, just recipes, a PR-scoped CI step, and the real-looking finding reported without its value
expectations: prek.toml has a builtin repo with detect-private-key and a https://github.com/Yelp/detect-secrets repo with detect-secrets using args --baseline .secrets.baseline
The detect-secrets exclude covers lock files, \.test_data\.json and the 60 MB data/export.json, and the same exclude is used when generating the baseline (so the scan does not run for 15+ minutes)
.secrets.baseline is generated and `git add`ed before prek run is used to verify the hooks
The connection-string finding in config/dev.yaml is left unaudited (not marked is_secret false), reported to the user by file:line and type without printing the value, and rotation is recommended
The justfile gets update-secrets-baseline and check-secrets recipes

A 'Secret detection (prek)' step is added to azure-pipelines.yml: PullRequest builds fetch the target branch into a private ref (refs/secret-scan/base) with --no-write-fetch-head and run prek with --from-ref/--to-ref, Schedule/Manual builds run --all-files, other builds exit 0
The pipeline diff only adds the new step: no existing step is modified (in particular nothing that sets or uses FETCH_HEAD)
The user is told that a Build validation policy on the target branch is needed for the step to run on PRs
